states.forward: pointing forward toward the twig tip, close to it (connivent)
states.spreading: standing out from the twig all round
states.two_ranked: in two flat rows either side of the twig
states.upswept: rising above the twig, a bare underside

change: needle_posture forward -> needle card lean toward the shoot tip and a bare lower shoot (the card controls `lean` and `bare` on draft plantgen#167); spreading -> current card

fit.method: pooled close-ups of the conifers Farjon describes as tufted at branch ends; values to fit

sources: Farjon, whitebark pine: dense tufts near branchlet ends, connivent, curved forward against shoot
Farjon: foliage tufted at branch ends in about 50 conifers (Araucaria, Callitris, Dacrydium, junipers, cedars, pines)
blast_radius: every Pinidae species that states needle_posture; none change until they state it
